function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

message.content:
Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on whether you’re looking for something local or something that can be delivered right to your door:

| Option | What it offers | How to order | Tips |
|--------|----------------|--------------|------|
| **Local bakeries** | Fresh, often custom‑made cakes; great for special occasions | Search “cake shop near me” on Google Maps or Yelp, call or visit the bakery’s website | Ask about delivery or pickup times; many bakeries accept online orders via their own site or through platforms like **Etsy** or **Shopify**. |
| **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide delivery, wide variety of flavors & designs | Websites: <https://www.baker.com>, <https://www.cakes.com>, <https://www.1-800-cake.com> | Check delivery radius, read reviews, and confirm the cake arrives on time. |
| **Grocery store chains** | Convenient, often same‑day delivery or pickup | Many stores (Walmart, Kroger, Safeway) have a “Bakery” section on their website or app | Look for “Same‑Day Delivery” or “Pickup” options. |
| **Specialty dessert shops** | Gourmet or themed cakes (e.g., vegan, gluten‑free, artisanal) | Search for specialty shops in your city; many have online ordering portals | Specify dietary restrictions early; some shops offer custom design services. |
| **Subscription boxes** | Monthly cake deliveries (great for regular treats) | Services like <https://www.cakebox.com> or <https://www.cakeclub.com> | Great for gifts or a recurring treat; check the subscription terms. |
| **DIY kits** | Order a cake kit and bake at home | Sites like <https://www.kitbake.com> or <https://www.cakekit.com> | Fun for parties or a cooking project; includes all ingredients and instructions. |

### Quick Steps to Order Online

1. **Choose a platform** – e.g., Baker.com, 1‑800‑Cake, or a local bakery’s website.
2. **Select your cake** – Pick flavor, size, and any custom decorations.
3. **Add to cart** – Provide delivery address, date/time, and any special instructions.
4. **Pay securely** – Most sites accept credit cards, PayPal, or Apple Pay.
5. **Confirm** – You’ll receive an email confirmation and a tracking link if delivery is involved.

### If You’re in a Specific City

Let me know your city or zip code, and I can pull up a list of top-rated local bakeries or delivery services that operate in your area. Happy cake hunting!
